mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS trainId, t.train_code AS trainCode, t.train_number AS trainNumber, IFNULL(COUNT(cn.id), 0) AS deviceCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN cn.status IS NOT NULL AND cn.status != '正常' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS spareDeviceCount FROM train_info t LEFT JOIN carriage_info c ON c.train_id = t.id LEFT JOIN compute_nodes cn ON cn.carriage_id = c.id WHERE t.id = #{trainId} GROUP BY t.id, t.train_code, t.train_number
SELECT COALESCE(status, '未知') AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM train_info WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} GROUP BY status
